•ie, lack of Hib/S. pneumoniae vax or PE suggesting meningitis
•EEG · LP · MRI occasionally to distinguish epilepsy/CNS infect - simple: ⍉further wrkup · complex: wrkup per age & clin

•Todd paralysis: localized paralysis/focal weakness after sz - min to hrs (up to 24h)
•brief (USU <15sec - ~10sec each) - ⍉aura · ⍉loss of postural tone · ⍉incont · simple automatisms (finger-fumbling)
•MC 4-6yo (or 5-8yo) - presents 4-10yo · girls - good prognosis: USU resolves b4 puberty
•genetic mut: NIPA1 (Mg transporter) · SLC2A1 (GLUT1) · GABA-A/GABA-B receptors · Ca/Cl channels
•slow-wave d/c from deep frontal & somatosensory cortex → rest of cortex → thalamus
•neuro exam · development & brain imaging USU norm (if ⍉underlying condition)
•often mistaken for inattention · may be misdx as anxiety or inattentive-type ADHD · ⍉fever-triggered
•hallmark of childhood absence epilepsy = MC form of pediatric epilepsy
•can occur multi times/d - sudden & complete arrest of activity (staring into space)
•⍉recollection of episode - may go unnoticed for long time → learning difficulties in school
•ddx juvenile myoclonic epilepsy: teens - myoclonic jerks (MC AM) + absence sz + GTC sz (MC AM) - ⍉fever-triggered · ⍉@ 2yo
•MC: chg in med regimen of pt w sz dx
•labs: CBC · CMP · blood cx · UA & urine tox · serum antiseizure med levels
•head CT · LP if infect sus · EEG (cont spike-and-wave)
-lorazepam IV or IM - repeat dose if sz persists - >2 doses → ↑resp depression risk
- if sz persists 10min after 2 lorazepam doses
-levetiracetam: easy use · rapid admin · equivalent efficacy
-valproate: well tolerated · less sedating than barbiturates - may cause hypotension

•absence: symmetric gen 3 Hz spike-and-wave - abrupt onset & termination
•BIPDs (bilat independent periodic discharges): CNS infect · anoxic encephalopathy · severe chronic epilepsy - poor prognosis
•bilat synchronous & symmetric slow activity: encephalopathy · neurodegen dz · gen epilepsy - may be norm

•LPDs (lateralized periodic discharges): lateralized persistent spikes · sharp or slow waves w fairly regular repetition - cerebral infarct · cerebral hemorrhage · encephalitis · rapidly growing cerebral malig
-↑sz threshold · suppresses spike-and-wave · ↓motor cortex transmission - AEs: N/V · sleep disturb · drowsiness · hyperactivity - target 20mg/kg/d
-start 5-10mg/kg/d ÷ BID if <6yo · 250mg BID if ≥6yo - check levels after 1-3wks (therapeutic 40-100mcg/mL)
